rules: Assessment reads and permitted internal drafts use existing scoped permission. Mission selection grants no customer-contact, spending, price, scheduling, transfer, purchase or payment authority.

Consequential actions bind current server-derived companyId, capability, exact immutable plan/content/offer version, target/service/customer scope, channels, resources, costs, grant validity and expiry.

Shared pilot contact cap is at most two follow-up attempts in seven days per service intent across missions, subject to method-specific cadence. Essential transactional notice exemptions remain unresolved under OM-D05.

Cancellation removes sponsorship; an action continues only if another independently valid approval covers the identical remaining payload, exposure and resource use. Pause prevents new dispatch while in-flight effects remain visible and reconciled.

A draft replacement does not revoke the approved active version. Accepted replacement atomically changes the active pointer; obsolete unstarted work becomes invalid while in-flight evidence is preserved.

Filter required qualifications, actual availability, service area, customer windows, travel, duration and buffers before ranking. Equal job counts alone are not a reason to reschedule.

Unknown required parts create verification; a diagnostic appointment uses its actual known requirements instead of invented repair parts.
Use field-specific freshness and source versions. The proposed fifteen-minute planning cache never bypasses execution-time mutable-fact checks.

Do not substitute legacy paid/invoiced/estimated fallbacks for new earned-revenue truth; routine outcome accounting is deterministic and uses no model calls.
At most two independently selected strategies and one paid channel per plan. A coordinator consumes no strategy slot.
Only explicitly declared finite dependencies may be attached. No recursion or model-generated/dynamic dependency expansion is allowed.
Inquiry conversion, fulfillment prerequisites, measurement and reconciliation may be bounded support. All support still consumes shared authority, contact, resource, model and financial budgets.
A strategy-classified dependency counts as a strategy. No runtime reclassification or silent duplicate child-mission budget can evade the limits.
Monthly revenue is the commercial umbrella. Suitable external acquisition is an early complete path and does not require internal recovery or a full Organize scan.

At most three automatic dispatch attempts apply only to accepted retry-safe adapters. Unknown provider effects require reconciliation before retry; mandatory deterministic cleanup and reconciliation continue when new work is budget-blocked.
